s: I'm Maya, and with me is my friend Lena.
Today we are going to talk about money and shopping, a topic we all live with every day.
Yes, money and shopping are part of daily life.
We buy food, we pay rent, and we all dream about things we want to buy.
Are you a careful shopper, or do you buy things fast?
At the start of each month, I look at the amount of money I have, and I make a small plan.
Before I buy anything big, I check my bank account.
My bank account shows me what I can really spend.
If the amount in your bank account is small, you wait.
If the amount is good, you can buy.
Last week, I wanted a new winter coat.
I checked my bank account and I asked myself, can I afford this coat?
And could you afford it, Maya?
Yes, I could afford it, because I saved a little money each week.
But some months, I cannot afford the things I want, and that is fine.
I cannot afford a new car right now.
A car costs a large amount of money, and I do not want a bank loan for it.
A bank loan is a serious choice.
With a bank loan, you borrow money from the bank, and you must pay back a fixed amount every month.
You must be sure you can afford those payments.
My brother took out a bank loan to buy his car.
He pays the same amount every month, and he says it is fine, but he must plan well.

Do you like to shop online, or do you like to go to a store?
I like both, but I love to stay at home and shop online.
At home, I can take my time, compare prices, and think before I buy.
I love to stay at home too.
At home, there is no rush, and I can check the amount again before I pay.
Shopping at home helps me save money.
Yes, and when you shop at home, you can cook your own food too, and that saves a big amount over the month.
Last month, I stayed at home more, I cooked more, and the amount I spent was much smaller.
A happy bank account is a good thing.
Did you buy anything nice last month?
I bought new shoes, but only after I checked my bank account twice.
I asked, can I afford these shoes?
The answer was yes, so I bought them.
Ask first, can I afford it, and check your bank account before you pay.
And never take a bank loan for shoes or a coat.
A bank loan is for big things, like a car or a house, not for small shopping.
A bank loan for a small thing is a bad idea, because you pay back a bigger amount in the end.
Know the amount you have, check your bank account, buy only what you can afford, and enjoy life at home when you can.
And remember, you do not need a bank loan to be happy.
A quiet evening at home with good food and good friends is worth more than a big shopping bag.
